observations: All six candidate-packet content byte lengths/SHA256 hashes were independently recomputed. Direct baseline tree maps the producer, baseline checker and adapter to their stated full Git identities.

Entire checker is reproduced from baseline by exactly two unique replacements: module contract text and the actuation world-linkage conditional. Reverse substitution restores the entire baseline byte-for-byte. Thus imports, dataclasses/report shape, chain verifier invocation/early return, first-screen selection, binding collection, lifecycle logic, unknown event kinds and CLI input/output/exit behavior are unchanged outside the intended finding semantics.

The unchanged producer writes screen_pass.world_hash from state.world_hash and simulated_actuation.before_world_hash from that same state.world_hash; the new condition checks that existing relationship without recomputing world state or adding authority.

For every recorded actuation, each binding independently requires a string whose strip() result is nonempty. Missing/null/empty/whitespace/non-string values cannot yield a clean world link even when equal to each other. A later deficient actuation still contributes a finding after an earlier valid one; existing issue deduplication only collapses repeated diagnostic text.

strip() is used solely as a truth predicate. The stored identity is not assigned, trimmed, case-folded, normalized, parsed as hex or otherwise replaced. Equality compares the two original strings, so arbitrary exact nonblank labels, including surrounding spaces, remain admitted; differing original strings remain findings.

These new checks are inside the existing for-actuation loop. Empty, rejection-only, unknown-kind and unfinished nonactuated histories gain no world-binding requirement. Existing lifecycle findings and invalid-chain behavior remain effective.

The new maintained tests derive their normal four-event history through the actual unchanged producer, rebuild deliberately altered histories through AuditLog, check both direct replay and unchanged decision_trace delivery, and assert input equality. Ten source-read test methods cover availability, equal invalid values, opaque labels, non-normalization, prefixes, unknown/reject, later invalid actuation, broken chain and captured stdin behavior. None was executed by this reviewer.

The guide accurately distinguishes complete recorded actuation links from completeness/authenticity of a saved history. It explicitly excludes after-world validation, aircraft-motion reconstruction, approval authentication, policy rerun and actuation/repair; legacy exact-string compatibility is documented.

The production delta is generic type/presence/equality logic only. It contains no root/author fixture values, scene identifiers, expected digest literals, fixture-specific branching, external fixture imports, test callbacks or qualification-packet-dependent behavior.
scope_limits: Static source/integrity review only; no author/root test rerun, parser/compiler invocation, native/host/process/browser/UI receiving.
Root's independent source-blind22-group execution and author10+13 API execution are separate evidence, not claimed by this review.
No planner, actuation, producer, adapter, UI controls, dependency, host, route, workflow or source-ref mutation.
This accepts the bounded per-record world-link completeness correction, not every pre-existing malformed-Python-object or saved-history completeness behavior.
integration: Preserve exact product/test/guide leaves and include this review plus two-hunk proof unchanged. A fresh final-tree/source comparison remains separate from this source-packet acceptance.
